$comment: AGE-1095. Verbatim mirror of VibeWebAgent/scripts/status/endpoints.json (private repo) -- the single canonical endpoint registry both the oncall-health-sweep.yml cron and this public status page consume. scripts/generate-status.mjs in THIS repo reads this file directly (not a separate hardcoded list), and VibeWebAgent's CI runs a parity check (tests/unit/issue-1095-status-page-parity.test.js) that fetches this exact file over the public unauthenticated GitHub raw URL and fails if it drifts from the private registry -- so this can never silently go stale. tee_attestation is deliberately absent: AGE-1053 delisted TEE/Confidential Mode from the shipped product. PH-5: user_portal and subscription_api were added on BOTH sides in companion PRs (this repo's PR must merge FIRST -- the parity guard in the private repo fetches this file's raw URL on main), and the api_health_readiness entry was renamed (name only; its id is unchanged so the cron's jq selectors keep working) to "LiteLLM Gateway (readiness)" because that URL is LiteLLM's own readiness endpoint -- labelling it "API" left a reader unable to tell whether the LLM gateway was up. The parity check compares id/url/check, so this header text may differ from the private registry's header; the endpoints array must not.
